title: US payroll, Engagement AI, more control over Time Away balances, and much more…
summary: Quite a big month coming for you from the Humaans team! This month we announced we’re bringing US payroll to Humaans, and Engagement AI has gone live, with AI that highlights trends and creates reports you can action immediately. There are also a number of exciting additions, such as more control over time away balances, and an improved way to handle compensation types. Read on.
